universe_and_method: Secondary report of Locomotiva/QuestionPro survey; 1,557 adults 18+ nationwide; fieldwork 2026-02-25 to 2026-03-13; Easter intent context
observed_fact: 90% reported intent to buy Easter-related chocolate; 61% named price as the main choice factor, followed by ingredient quality 53%, size 44%, known brand 43%, variety 40%; 69% considered Easter eggs unfairly priced versus bars of equal weight
represents: Reported stated intent and stated choice criteria in a seasonal survey
does_not_represent: Actual purchases, continuous-year category demand, causality, brand switching, current October behavior
signal_candidate: Price/value scrutiny with continued seasonal participation; format/value alternatives merit follow-up
limitations: Survey is seasonal and self-reported; source reports survey results, not observed transactions. Not independent from the survey itself.

universe_and_method: Secondary report of AtlasIntel survey; 2,154 respondents nationwide; fieldwork 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-30; Easter consumption plans
observed_fact: 54.7% said they would celebrate Easter with chocolate bars; 44.7% industrial eggs; 34.2% artisanal eggs; 45.3% bonbons
represents: Reported planned format choices in a separate Easter survey
does_not_represent: Actual purchases, annual category trend, exact market shares, causal substitution
signal_candidate: Non-egg formats may be meaningful alternatives during high-price seasonal occasions
limitations: Different survey from CAP-20261015-001; still seasonal, self-reported and not transaction data. Percentages may overlap because respondents could select multiple formats.

universe_and_method: FGV IBRE Easter basket price release; year-over-year basket changes and four-year cumulative comparison
observed_fact: The Easter basket average fell 6.77% in 2025 and 5.73% in 2026 year over year, while chocolates and bonbons remained on a continuous upward price trajectory over the four-year period
represents: Industry/consumer price context with divergent aggregate and item-level movement
does_not_represent: Retailer-level shelf prices, shopper intent, exact chocolate SKU movements, current October prices
signal_candidate: Category price pressure may differ from the headline Easter basket; inspect item-level and format-level prices
limitations: Aggregate Easter basket declines do not mean chocolate itself became cheaper; this is not a shopper-behavior measure.

universe_and_method: Secondary report of Cielo broad retail index; September 2026 versus September 2025
observed_fact: Real retail sales fell 3.9% year over year in September 2026; e-commerce sales grew 5.1% nominally while physical retail fell 0.1% nominally
represents: Macro retail context that may shape value-seeking and channel mix
does_not_represent: Chocolate-specific demand, chocolate e-commerce performance, causal explanation of category movement
signal_candidate: Current consumption backdrop is pressured; check whether chocolate shows the same or different pattern
independence_group: Cielo retail index reported by UOL
limitations: All-retail data, not chocolate-specific; online growth is nominal while overall headline is real, so these figures are not directly comparable.

universe_and_method: ETENE sector note on cocoa production, grinding and global supply; published June 2026
observed_fact: The note attributes the 2025 cocoa price decline to weaker demand alongside higher production after a historic price spike; it flags 2026 uncertainty due to potential El Niño impacts
represents: Commodity/supply context relevant to cost and price transmission hypotheses
does_not_represent: Shopper behavior, retail prices, chocolate sales, brand pricing decisions
signal_candidate: Input-market changes are a plausible context variable but must be tested against retail price observations
independence_group: Banco do Nordeste ETENE sector note
limitations: Supply-side evidence only; no direct shopper or SKU-level price observations.

universe_and_method: Trade publication homepage/article dated 2026-10-09; industry coverage, not primary shopper data
observed_fact: The publication reports 25.3% growth in cocoa reception for crop 2025/26 and says grinding/export derivatives rebounded in Q3 while Jan-Sep processing remained 18.5% below 2023
does_not_represent: Shopper demand, retail sales, brand pricing or causal consumer response
signal_candidate: Supply-chain indicators are mixed and should remain a separate signal family
limitations: Trade-media report; underlying data source/methodology should be checked before quantifying an external-facing claim.

universe_and_method: Newsroom field visit to nine supermarkets plus a municipal market and chocolate shops; Easter 2026 price snapshots
observed_fact: The report observed small Easter eggs around R$20–R$40, known-brand eggs from roughly R$50 and bars around R$5.99 to R$13 for 145g in the visited outlets
represents: Historical, local, seasonal price examples from a limited physical-store sample
does_not_represent: National average price, current October prices, representative retail time series or causal shopper substitution
signal_candidate: Format/price comparisons are worth measuring directly per 100g across stores and dates
limitations: April Easter snapshots from a limited set of outlets; cannot be used as current price or longitudinal series.

universe_and_method: Public product detail for Lacta milk chocolate 80g; site methodology says daily automated collection from supermarket online stores and product-level matching
observed_fact: Page reports 280 observations from 211 markets in 177 identified cities between 2026-04-01 and 2026-09-26; SP sample 149 observations from 96 markets in 78 cities; SP mean R$8.89 and +1.1% between August and September monthly means
represents: Secondary retail price time-series context for one named 80g product
does_not_represent: Complete national retail, sales weighting, physical shelf prices, shopper behavior, causal price drivers
signal_candidate: A public retail source provides a historical comparison path; evaluate repeated SKU price changes and geographic dispersion
independence_group: CustoPorPrato collection; source pages underlying data are supermarket sites
limitations: Non-probability online-store sample; coverage and dates vary; same retailer network may appear in multiple cities; not official inflation index. Source page displays summary but raw underlying rows were not exported.

universe_and_method: Dated public recipe editorial page published 2026-07-10; one recipe roundup, not a measured content corpus
observed_fact: The page features baked chocolate mousse and references additional chocolate dessert recipes including zucchini chocolate mousse and brownie
represents: One example of publicly published recipe themes and preparation formats
does_not_represent: Recipe popularity, frequency across the web, shopper demand, purchase behavior, emerging trend
signal_candidate: Use as a seed source for a repeatable recipe-language/content capture; no trend claim from one page
limitations: Single page and one publication date; content appearance does not establish prevalence or growth. Do not copy recipe text.

universe_and_method: Public product detail for Lacta Diamante Negro 80g; latest collection date shown 2026-09-08; methodology describes daily automated collection from supermarket online stores
observed_fact: Page reports 105 markets across 7 states; national median R$9.76; São Paulo average R$9.76; state averages range from R$7.20 in PR to R$12.34 in BA; page says São Paulo average rose 1.5% since August 2026
represents: Secondary online retail price context for a second 80g chocolate SKU
does_not_represent: Full category price level, representative national price, sell-out, shopper behavior, causal price drivers
signal_candidate: A second SKU provides a cross-product check on observed retail price dispersion; test whether variation is persistent across repeated observations
limitations: Same source family as Lacta ao leite 80g; not independent corroboration. Non-probability online-store sample; page says state coverage varies. Exact history window and sample composition should be checked before trend interpretation.

universe_and_method: Public product detail for Nestlé Diplomata 80g; latest collection date shown 2026-08-12
observed_fact: The product detail page inspected manually displayed 43 markets across 3 states, national median R$9.98, São Paulo average R$9.19 and Minas Gerais R$11.03, with latest collection shown as 2026-08-12. A separate search-result rendering for the same URL showed a different summary (45 observations, 33 markets/cities, coverage through 2026-09-26).
represents: Secondary online retail price context for a Nestlé 80g SKU
does_not_represent: Current October price, broad national representation, shopper behavior, sell-out, causal price drivers
signal_candidate: Third SKU broadens category/brand coverage but illustrates uneven product availability in the aggregator
limitations: The same URL rendered conflicting summary statistics between the search result and opened page; the observation is quarantined from quantitative synthesis until a stable dated capture is verified. Same source family as other CustoPorPrato records; not independent.

universe_and_method: Public product detail for Suflair Duo 80g; latest collection shown 2026-09-26; São Paulo subset through 2026-09-08
observed_fact: Page reports 14 observations in 11 markets and 14 identified cities; São Paulo average R$11.28 from 9 observations across 9 markets/cities; page reports +9.3% between August and September 2026 monthly averages
represents: Secondary online retail price context for a Nestlé Suflair 80g SKU
does_not_represent: Full category price movement, representative national price, sell-out, shopper behavior, causal price drivers
signal_candidate: A larger reported monthly change on this SKU merits repeated monitoring, not a trend claim
limitations: Same aggregator/source family as other product pages; low sample size; page indicates unequal date coverage and non-probability online price sample. The displayed page's last collection is 2026-09-26 nationally and 2026-09-08 for SP.

universe_and_method: Public product page for Lacta Laka Oreo 80g; one dated collection shown as 2026-09-08; six markets and six cities identified
observed_fact: Page reports SP mean R$7.99, MG R$10.99 and AL R$11.99; 6 observations across 6 markets/cities; reports a 29.2% decline between August and September monthly averages for the SP subset
represents: Secondary online retail price context for a flavored 80g Lacta SKU
does_not_represent: Category price movement, representative national price, sales, shopper preference, causal drivers
signal_candidate: The large monthly percentage change is worth verifying with repeated observations; the visible collection count is small
limitations: Single dated collection; very small sample; monthly change can be sensitive to market coverage and price promotions. Same source family as other aggregator pages.

universe_and_method: Public product page for Lacta Ao Leite 80g bar; collection range 2026-08-12 to 2026-09-26; 12 observations across 12 markets/cities
observed_fact: Page reports regional averages from R$8.99 in PE to R$12.29 in SP; reference median R$9.99; coverage includes five states
represents: Secondary online retail price context for a standard 80g Lacta milk-chocolate bar
does_not_represent: A simultaneous national quote, representative price, sales, shopper behavior, causal drivers
signal_candidate: A regional price-spread candidate for repeat capture; this page's 12 observations are smaller and less broad than the Lacta Ao Leite 80g page with 280 observations
limitations: Different product-page URL/SKU definition and coverage than the other Lacta Ao Leite 80g series; don't merge series without checking item identity.

universe_and_method: Public product page for Garoto Ao Leite 80g; collection date shown as 2026-09-08; ten markets across four states
observed_fact: Page reports national median R$8.74, state averages from R$7.98 in MG to R$10.98 in ES, SP mean R$7.99, and +5.8% since August in the SP subset
represents: Secondary online retail price context for a Garoto 80g SKU
does_not_represent: Category price movement, representative national price, sales, shopper preference, causal drivers
signal_candidate: Adds a second mainstream brand to the secondary price-monitoring set; reported change needs repeat capture and coverage checks
limitations: Single date shown for current regional snapshot; the SP historical comparison may use a changing set of markets. Same source family as other aggregator pages.

universe_and_method: Public product page for Classic 40% cocoa dark chocolate 80g; collection date shown as 2026-09-08; 51 markets across five states
observed_fact: Page reports national median R$11.08 and state averages from R$7.98 in SC to R$12.34 in SP; 51 markets in five states
represents: Secondary online retail price context for a dark chocolate 40% cocoa 80g SKU
does_not_represent: Full category price distribution, sales, shopper preference, price elasticity, causal drivers
signal_candidate: Adds a different chocolate type/price tier for future like-for-like monitoring; variant and category definition must remain explicit
limitations: Only five states represented; non-probability online sample; different type and cocoa percentage from milk chocolate; not an equivalent SKU comparison.

universe_and_method: Public methodology page for the secondary online-price aggregator
observed_fact: The page states coverage of 597,451 products in 463 supermarkets across 270 cities and 27 states, with 3,279,896 prices in the 2026-09-26 collection; data are collected daily from supermarket websites. It states the sample is non-probabilistic, not consumption-weighted, can vary by state/online coverage, and is not an official inflation index.
represents: Methodology and limitations for interpreting the product-price pages
does_not_represent: Retail market share, all-store coverage, official inflation, shopper purchases, causes of price movements
signal_candidate: Use as source-level method note; it materially limits the confidence and comparability of every product-page statistic from this family
limitations: Same publisher as the product pages; its own methodology warns of non-probability sample, uneven regional digital coverage, changing markets/products, and price differences vs physical shelves. Reuse terms still require review.
